title: Veeam closes critical backup product gap allowing unauthenticated access to CDP service
content_md:
Veeam closed gaps in its backup products, one of them critical. Because of that, an attacker without logging in reached the CDP service.

via Mastodon https://www.heise.de/news/Veeam-Backup-Server-manipulierbar-und-MFA-deaktivierbar-11502821.html
